question: Can selector v2 place exactly 50 structural-event-preserving anchors over the full arc-length extent of every fixed tunnel topology while maintaining at least 5 m global spacing and at most 7.5 m same-tunnel coverage radius?
reason_now: The v1 selector passed exact count and spacing checks but complete-map review exposed severe unsampled regions, including 32.780 m maximum same-tunnel coverage radius on P01 and 92.306 m on P03. LiDAR rerun is therefore blocked until full-spline coverage is explicitly constrained and visually verified.

method.event_stage: Preserve terminal, junction-center/offset and strongest horizontal-turn event neighborhoods first.
method.quota_stage: Allocate the remaining non-event anchor quota across tunnels in proportion to spline arc length by deterministic largest remainder.
method.candidate_stage: Interpolate candidates and coverage probes every 0.5 m of spline arc length, independent of upstream spline-knot density.
method.optimization_stage: Solve a deterministic binary mixed-integer program with exact per-tunnel fill quotas, at least 5 m global Euclidean spacing and complete same-tunnel coverage within 7.5 m of an event or selected fill anchor.
method.audit: Require exact count, pairwise spacing, structural-event coverage, every tunnel represented, observed fill quotas equal expected arc-length quotas, maximum same-tunnel coverage radius at most 7.5 m and byte-identical replay.

evidence.machine_readable: Five anchor JSON files, five per-parent coverage audits, frozen input hashes, P05 graph/spline, aggregate summary and deterministic replay hashes.
evidence.visual: Five complete X-Y/X-Z spline-and-anchor maps plus one aggregate spacing/coverage figure; all 250 anchors and all tunnel extents are shown with no best-case selection.
evidence.claim_boundary: A PASS validates only selector-v2 sample placement and permits review before a separately approved LiDAR rerun. It is not a sensor, dataset, learning, topology-runtime or navigation PASS.

execution_policy: One immutable execution only. Reuse no failed output directory; do not generate mesh or rays; do not lower count/spacing, relax coverage, change seeds/templates, retry or select a replacement topology.
stop_rule: Stop and seal if any source hash, topology family, exact count, spacing, event coverage, tunnel coverage, arc-length quota, full-spline coverage, replay, evidence, time or disk check fails.
data_card_policy: No data card is required because operation=infrastructure and this run creates zero sensor observations, labels, formal dataset samples or training inputs; exact source and sampling scope are frozen in this approved proposal and run spec.

estimated_cost.compute: One frozen-E1 CPU process using SciPy MILP, four read-only graph/spline inputs and one graph-only P05 construction; no mesh, Open3D raycasting, GPU, simulator or training.

approval.confirmation_reference: 用户在被明确告知当前只修复50个LiDAR采样位置铺满整条隧道、先做五图零射线验证且不训练、不采LiDAR、不改M-TARE后回复：继续
